verdict.rationale: Devin documents event-driven automations that run without the user. Auto-Fix lets Devin respond to review comments and CI failures "without you in the loop", Devin Review runs automated first-pass PR reviews, and cloud sessions keep running on their own VM after you close your laptop. Scheduling is exposed through the MCP server, and the API supports workflow automation. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of recurring scheduled automations (scheduling is only listed as an MCP capability), detail on configuring background triggers, and independent hands-on corroboration of these automations working reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: With Auto-Fix enabled, Devin automatically responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures — creating a closed loop where PRs iterate toward merge-ready quality without you in the loop.
The cloud session gets its own VM with a shell, browser, and full repo access, so it can keep going after you close your laptop.
it gives any MCP-compatible AI agent or IDE full access to session management, playbooks, knowledge, and scheduling
The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.
